description:
Provision-to-ready automation sprint (Dedicated Capacity & Fleet Management)

Goal
- Reduce “time-to-ready” for new Dedicated and shared GPU capacity by automating provisioning, standardizing golden images, and enforcing validated configuration gates.
- Make fleet bring-up repeatable across regions and GPU types while minimizing manual intervention and post-provision break/fix.

Scope (in-sprint)
- Image pipeline: build/version GPU node images (drivers, CUDA, NCCL, kubelet/containerd config, security hardening) with provenance and rollback.
- Provisioning automation: turn GPU instances from “allocated” -> “joined cluster” -> “ready for inference workloads” with orchestration steps and retries.
- Validation gates: pre-flight + post-flight checks (GPU health, driver/toolkit parity, networking, storage, runtime smoke test, perf canary) that must pass before a node is marked Ready.
- Control-plane integration: surface node readiness state and failure reasons to platform/fleet tooling; emit metrics and logs for triage.
- Observability + SLOs: dashboards/alerts for provision-to-ready P50/P95, failure rates by step, and top failure modes.
- Rollout: staged rollout by region and GPU type with feature flags and clear rollback plan.

Out of scope (deferred)
- Major scheduler changes, new cluster architectures, or large-scale region expansions.
- Customer-facing UX work beyond exposing readiness status and basic failure reason fields.

Key stakeholders
- Infra/Fleet: Vanessa Ortiz (EM), Keiko Yamamoto, Jamal Pierce, Nina Petrova, Harish Reddy
- SRE: Sean Gallagher (Dir), Rafael Mendes (Mgr), Miles Thornton, Aisha Bello
- Platform Control Plane: Priya Natarajan (VP), Ethan Park (EM), Benji Okafor, Jordan Lee
- Release Engineering: Connor O’Brien, Sahana Iyer
- Security/Compliance (consulted): Fiona McCarthy (SecOps) + security team for image hardening and access controls

Timeline (hypothetical)
- Week 1: baseline measurement + design/ADRs + validation checklist + initial image pipeline draft
- Weeks 2–3: implement orchestration steps + readiness API/state machine + first validations + dashboards
- Week 4: staged rollout (one region/GPU type), incident drills, hardening, and doc/runbook completion

Primary deliverables
- Golden image build and versioning process (including rollback)
- Automated provision-to-ready workflow with gating checks
- Readiness state model + metrics + dashboards + alerts
- Runbooks and on-call playbooks for common failure modes
- PRs implementing pipeline/config/observability changes, plus tickets tracking rollout and follow-ups

files.description: High-level architecture overview of the automated provisioning pipeline: stages, ownership boundaries (fleet vs control plane vs SRE), readiness state definitions, and how Dedicated pools are brought online.

ADR defining the canonical readiness state machine (Allocated/Provisioning/Validating/Ready/Quarantined), transitions, and what signals are authoritative (agent heartbeat, validation results, control-plane writes).
IaC conventions for dedicated GPU fleet provisioning: module structure, variable naming, tagging, region rollout toggles, and drift detection expectations.
Runbook for triaging provision-to-ready failures: common error signatures, where to look (logs/metrics), and safe remediation steps (reimage, drain, quarantine, retry validation).
Defines SLOs for time-to-ready (P50/P95), success rate, and error budget policy; includes alert thresholds and escalation criteria.
Service doc for the control-plane component that records readiness states, stores validation artifacts, exposes APIs to internal tooling, and emits telemetry.
Golden image process: build pipeline steps, version pinning policy, CVE patch cadence, driver/toolkit matrix, and rollback procedure with blast-radius controls.
Baseline configuration standard for GPU worker nodes (kernel params, container runtime settings, kubelet flags, time sync, ulimits, disk layout) and what is validated automatically.
Dashboard catalog and links: per-step latency breakdown, failure heatmaps by region/GPU type, quarantine counts, and validation flake rate.
Game day plan to test failure modes (image mismatch, driver install failure, kubelet join failure, NCCL test failure), expected mitigations, and success criteria.
Working spreadsheet-style doc capturing baseline time-to-ready metrics (before sprint): distributions by region/GPU type, manual steps, and top delay contributors.
Draft checklist of validations (pre/post): GPU health, driver parity, network throughput, storage IOPS, runtime smoke test, perf canary thresholds; includes open questions and owners.
Scratchpad for driver/CUDA/NCCL compatibility matrix and upgrade plan; notes from testing and links to failures.
SRE working notes for alerts: which metrics page, paging vs ticket thresholds, and noise/flake analysis during early rollout.
Draft rollout plan: stages, feature flags, region ordering, rollback triggers, comms plan, and release train alignment.
Early API notes for readiness state endpoints and event schema; includes sample payloads and integration notes for internal tools.
Draft policy for quarantine criteria (which validations trigger quarantine, auto-retry limits, and how quarantined nodes are surfaced to operators).
Plan for tracing/metrics instrumentation across provisioning steps: span names, tags, cardinality constraints, and data retention notes.
Ticket to define time-to-ready SLOs, metric names, and success criteria; includes discussion between Infra and SRE on alerting thresholds.
Control-plane implementation work for readiness states, transitions, and persistence; links to ADR and planned API contract.
Add validation checks for GPU health and driver parity; includes acceptance tests and edge cases (mixed GPU SKUs, driver drift).
Integrate NCCL all-reduce smoke tests to detect fabric issues early; includes perf/timeout tuning and flake mitigation.
Define retry policy per provisioning step, backoff, max attempts, and when to quarantine; includes SRE review comments.
Implement golden image version pinning, staged promotion (candidate->stable), and automated rollback hooks if validation failure rate spikes.
Create dashboards for step timings and failure rates; includes observability team input on cardinality and retention.
Write and review runbooks for common failure modes; references Slack/incident learnings and includes escalation paths.
Operational ticket for first staged rollout in one region/GPU type; includes checklists, sign-offs, and go/no-go notes.
Backlog ticket capturing flake reduction tasks discovered during rollout (NCCL timeout tuning, disk warmup, network jitter).
PM ticket to define customer-facing impact (faster Dedicated provisioning), what can be promised, and internal/external comms guidance.
Design ticket for presenting readiness state and failure reason in internal ops console: table views, filters, and drill-down.
PR adding readiness state model and internal APIs in the main control-plane repo; includes schema migration, authz checks, and basic integration tests.
PR to store per-node validation results (step name, duration, logs pointer) and expose failure reasons for triage tooling.
PR introducing feature flags/rollout toggles by region and pool type; includes kill switch behavior and documentation.
PR adding metrics and tracing spans for each provisioning/validation step; includes metric naming review from observability.
PR implementing quarantine logic after repeated failures, including safe defaults and operator override pathways.
PR adding a summarized readiness endpoint for internal UI/ops tooling (counts by state, top failures).
Terraform PR adding standardized tags/outputs used by provisioning automation (pool id, region, image channel), plus guardrails for required variables.
Terraform PR introducing rollout variables and defaults to constrain early rollouts to us-east + A100; includes plan output examples.
Helm PR deploying a node validation agent as a DaemonSet with RBAC, resource limits, and config for which checks run.
PR adding Grafana dashboards and alert rules for time-to-ready and failure rates; includes tuning notes and initial thresholds.
PR adding a lightweight inference/perf canary that runs after provisioning to validate real workload readiness and catches regressions early.
Follow-up PR to reduce metric cardinality after early rollout (e.g., removing per-node IDs from tags) and to backfill dashboards.
PR improving robustness of validation agent (timeouts, retry logic, log bundling) based on flake reports from the staged rollout.
Docs PR updating internal operational docs for fleet readiness: how to interpret states, how to remediate, and links to dashboards/runbooks.
PR adding an incident template/playbook for provisioning failures: required fields, quick links, and suggested owner rotations.
PR enforcing readiness gates so nodes cannot join serving pools until validations pass; includes rollback toggle and safety checks.
PR emitting audit events when image channel/version changes for a pool (candidate->stable), to support compliance and post-incident forensics.
PR adding SLI computations for time-to-ready using event timestamps from provisioning and readiness services; includes tests for edge cases.
Thread coordinating baseline measurement: what timestamp defines 'allocated', where we get 'ready', and which system is source of truth.
Thread debugging a golden image bake failure (driver install mismatch) and deciding whether to pin CUDA minor version for the sprint.
Thread debating validation gate ordering (network vs GPU health vs kubelet join) and how to make failures actionable.
Thread aligning control-plane readiness state machine fields and naming; includes quick API payload sketches.
Thread on SLO proposal for time-to-ready and initial alert thresholds; includes concerns about paging noise during rollout.
Thread reviewing ADR draft: whether readiness should be event-sourced or stored as current state; includes trade-offs and decision.
Thread on quarantine policy: auto-quarantine after N failures vs always reimage; includes ops input from capacity operations.
Thread coordinating rollout window and release train alignment; includes checklist for staged rollout and rollback owner.
Thread investigating NCCL smoke test flakes and proposing timeout/backoff changes; includes logs snippets.
Thread asking for dashboard links and agreeing on what metrics are safe (cardinality) before enabling alerts.
Thread on authz for readiness APIs (who can mutate state vs read-only) and how to log audit events for image channel changes.
Thread about Terraform outputs needed by provisioning orchestrator; includes proposed variable names and module changes.
Thread coordinating validation agent DaemonSet rollout and required RBAC; includes helm values snippet.
Thread preparing on-call: how to interpret 'Validating' stuck nodes, when to quarantine, and when to page Infra vs Platform.
Thread for a minor incident during early rollout where nodes failed readiness due to metric tag explosion; includes quick mitigation and follow-ups.
Thread collecting notes for a lightweight incident review: timeline, contributing factors, and action items into Linear.
Thread confirming staged rollout criteria for us-east A100 pool: success metrics, stop conditions, and sign-off list.
Thread tuning alert thresholds after first week of data; includes discussion of paging vs ticketing.
Thread on adding readiness gate before nodes join serving pool; includes questions about fallback behavior if capacity is tight.
Thread about image rollback: when to auto-rollback and how to prevent flip-flopping between candidate/stable.
Thread coordinating GPU health check thresholds (ECC errors, Xid codes) and what is considered 'quarantine-worthy'.
Thread tracking open issues for second-stage rollout (another region) and dependencies on networking changes.
Thread confirming release notes wording for internal consumers and whether changes need a formal change-management entry.
Thread reviewing runbook draft and requesting edits to make remediation steps safer (drain/quarantine/reimage order).
Thread asking for a gameday to validate incident response; includes proposed scenarios and owners.
Customer support ticket reporting slower-than-expected Dedicated pool readiness; includes environment details, timestamps, and investigation linking to provisioning metrics.
Support ticket where additional nodes fail post-provision validations; includes logs, workaround (reimage), and links to runbook and GitHub PR fix.
Internal helpdesk ticket requesting access to new dashboards and readiness tooling; includes approvals and least-privilege discussion.
Support escalation: too many nodes quarantined, causing temporary throughput drop; includes mitigation plan and follow-up to tune validation thresholds.
Leadership-oriented email thread (Irene/Neha/Priya) aligning on sprint goals, success metrics, and weekly reporting cadence for time-to-ready reduction.
Email thread requesting and documenting go/no-go approval for the first staged rollout; includes checklist, risk assessment, and rollback plan.
Email coordination between SRE leadership and Infra on paging coverage, alert thresholds, and incident ownership during rollout week.

Partner technical deep-dive transcript with cloud provider TAM/SA: instance bring-up issues, image baking constraints, and networking quirks affecting time-to-ready; ends with action items and next sync.
